msg.remote_path_hint: File or folder on the server
btn.list_remote: List the server's folders to choose from
msg.remote_truncated: Only the first {count} entries are shown
msg.remote_browse_hint: Click a folder to open it or a file to choose it; double-click a file to fetch it.
msg.remote_agent_hint: Signs in with the keys ssh-agent holds (or Pageant on Windows), then those ~/.ssh/config names for the server, or else ~/.ssh/id_ed25519, id_ecdsa and id_rsa.
msg.ftp_plain_warning: Plain FTP sends your password and files unencrypted: anyone on the network between here and the server can read them. Use FTPS or SFTP if the server offers it.
msg.reload_remote_discards: Fetching the server's copy again replaces the changes made here that were not saved to the server yet.
msg.sftp_lookup: Cannot look up the address of {host}
msg.sftp_lookup_slow: Looking up the address of {host} took too long
msg.sftp_password: {server} refused this user name and password
msg.sftp_agent: {server}: signing in with ssh-agent failed. Check that ssh-agent is running and holds a key the server accepts (ssh-add -l lists them)
msg.ftps_cert_changed: The certificate of {server} has changed since you chose to trust it. This could mean someone is between this program and the server, or that the server's certificate was renewed. If you are sure the server is genuine, remove its line (starting with "{id} ") from {file}
msg.ftps_unknown_cert: This program has not connected to {server} before, and no certificate authority vouches for its certificate (it may be self-signed). Check that this fingerprint matches the server's certificate before trusting it:
msg.ftps_handshake: The secure (TLS) connection to the server failed
msg.ftp_bad_reply: The server sent a reply this program does not understand
msg.ftp_bad_name: A file or folder name with a line break cannot be used over FTP
msg.ftp_password_only: FTP signs in with a password only
msg.ftp_truncated: The download was cut short: the server's encrypted connection ended before all of the file arrived. Try again.
msg.ftp_out_of_step: The connection to the server got out of step after an earlier error. Connect again.
msg.ftps_unsupported: {server} does not offer a secure (TLS) connection: {reply}
msg.remote_not_deleted: {path} changed on the server after it was fetched, so it was not deleted there
msg.remote_created_meanwhile: {path} was created on the server after the folder was fetched, so it was not overwritten. Your file is kept here; compare it with the server's to merge them.
msg.remote_partly_written: {path} was only partly written on the server before the upload stopped. Save again to finish writing it.
msg.remote_unchanged: {path} on the server was not changed.
msg.remote_uncertain: The connection was lost while {path} was being replaced on the server, so it could not be checked which version it now holds. Check it there; the other version is kept as {left}.
msg.remote_left_over: A temporary file could not be removed from the server, and can be deleted: {path}
msg.remote_verify_failed: The copy uploaded for {path} did not match the file here, so it was not used.
msg.remote_reload_kept: The copy fetched before could not be put back; it is kept at {path}
msg.remote_local_unreadable: The local copy {path} is missing or cannot be read in full, so nothing was saved to the server
msg.remote_not_written_back: The synchronization stopped part way and was undone in the local copy of the server's folder, so nothing was written back to the server
msg.remote_active_hint: The server connects back to this computer for each transfer, for servers without passive mode. Firewalls and NAT routers usually block it.
msg.remote_ssh_config_hint: Host aliases, users, ports, keys and jump hosts in ~/.ssh/config are followed as ssh follows them; a ProxyJump or ProxyCommand there takes the proxy's place.
msg.proxy_bad: Not a proxy address: {proxy}. Write socks5://host:port or http://host:port.
msg.proxy_url_password: A proxy address must not contain a password: it would end up in shell histories and process lists. Set {var} instead.
msg.proxy_refused: The proxy {proxy} did not connect to {server}
msg.proxy_not_socks: The proxy did not answer as a SOCKS5 proxy does
msg.proxy_not_http: The proxy did not answer as an HTTP proxy does
msg.proxy_sign_in: The proxy refused the user name or password
msg.ssh_config_unreadable: Cannot read the SSH configuration file {file}
msg.ssh_bad_name: Not a server or user name SSH accepts: {name}. It must not start with '-' or contain spaces, quotes, control characters or any of $ ; & | < > ( ) \ `.
msg.ssh_too_many_jumps: More than {count} jump hosts lead to the server; ~/.ssh/config may send the connection round in a loop
msg.ssh_jump_refused: The jump host {jump} did not connect to {server}
msg.ssh_no_key_accepted: The server accepted none of the keys tried
msg.sftp_cert_invalid: The host certificate of {server} cannot be trusted: {why}
msg.ftp_active_proxy: Active-mode FTP cannot go through a proxy, since the server connects back to this computer directly. Turn off active mode or the proxy.
msg.ftp_active_timeout: The server did not connect back for the transfer (active mode). A firewall or NAT router in between may be blocking it; try passive mode.
msg.ftps_client_cert_unreadable: Cannot read a certificate or private key (PEM) from {file}
msg.ftps_client_cert_bad: The client certificate {file} and its private key do not match, or the key's type is not supported
msg.remote_url_bad: Not a server path: {url}. Write it like sftp://user@host:22/folder/file (or ftp://, ftpes://, ftps://).
msg.remote_url_password: Don't put a password in the address: anyone who sees the command line or the job file could read it. Set it in the OXIDEMERGE_REMOTE_PASSWORD environment variable instead.
msg.remote_url_no_password: The FTP server needs a password: set it in the {var} environment variable.
msg.remote_trust_hint: If this is the right server, run again with --trust-fingerprint {fingerprint} to trust it.
msg.sftp_key: Could not sign in to {server} with this key: check the key file, its passphrase, and that the server accepts it
msg.sftp_key_changed: The key of {server} has changed since the last connection to it. This could mean someone is between this program and the server, or that the server was reinstalled or its key renewed. If you are sure the server is genuine, remove its line (starting with "{id} ") from {file}
msg.sftp_known_hosts_unreadable: Could not read the list of trusted servers, {file}
msg.sftp_unknown_host: This program has not connected to {server} before. Check that this fingerprint matches the server's {type} key before trusting it:
msg.sftp_ssh_mismatch: Warning: this key differs from the one {file} records for this server. Someone may be between this program and the server.
msg.sftp_no_host_key: The server sent no host key
msg.sftp_cannot_write: {path}: cannot write it on the server
msg.sftp_not_regular: {path} is neither a regular file nor a folder
msg.sftp_too_many: Stopped after {count} files and folders; fetch a smaller folder
msg.sftp_too_large: Stopped after {size}; fetch a smaller file or folder
msg.sftp_too_deep: Stopped at {path}: folders are nested more than {count} deep
msg.sftp_changed_on_server: {path} changed on the server after it was opened, so it was not overwritten. Your edits are kept here; compare them with the server's version to merge them.
msg.remote_local_skipped: {path} was left as it is on the server: here it is a link, a special file, or has a name that is not valid Unicode
msg.sftp_upload_failed: Could not upload {name}; the edits are kept here, and Save tries again. {error}
msg.sftp_saved_unchecked: {path} was saved on the server, but how it is there now could not be read back, so saving it again will be refused until it is opened again.
msg.sftp_original_moved: The server's original file could not be put back, and is now at {path}.
msg.sftp_key_changed_ssh: The key of {server} does not match the one {file} records for it, or {file} revokes it. This could mean someone is between this program and the server, or that the server was reinstalled or its key renewed. If you are sure the server is genuine, remove its old key with: ssh-keygen -R "{host}"
msg.sftp_key_revoked: The key of {server} is marked revoked in {file}: it must not be trusted, so the connection was refused. Ask the server's administrator about its current key.
msg.workspace_exists: A workspace named “{name}” already exists. Saving replaces its tabs with the open ones.
msg.workspace_nothing: None of the open tabs can be saved in a workspace: tabs of temporary copies (fetched over SFTP/FTP, from a revision or an archive), the clipboard, and All differences or review tabs have nothing to reopen from.
msg.workspace_left_out: {n} open tabs have nothing to reopen from and were left out.
msg.workspace_not_reopened: {n} of the workspace’s {total} tabs could not be reopened: a file of each is gone or can’t be opened.
msg.clipboard_hint: Paste a second text with Ctrl+V into the right side to compare it with the clipboard
msg.clipboard_unavailable: The system clipboard is not available
msg.clipboard_empty: The clipboard has no text to compare
msg.clipboard_busy: Another program is using the clipboard; try again in a moment
msg.clipboard_not_text: The clipboard holds something that can’t be read as text
msg.clipboard_failed: The clipboard could not be read: {err}
msg.clipboard_too_large: The clipboard text is larger than {n} MiB; save it to a file to compare it
binary.moved_hint: Highlight matching byte blocks at different offsets.
msg.extract_truncated: [the rest of the file is left out: it is longer than 16 MiB of text]
msg.notebook_truncated: [only the first {max} of the notebook’s {n} cells are shown]
msg.extract_incomplete: [some of the file could not be read, so this text is incomplete: {reason}]
opt.extract_documents: Read documents, spreadsheets and ELF files as text
opt.extract_documents_hint: Compare .pdf, .docx, .odt, .rtf, .xlsx and .ods as the text and sheets in them, .ipynb notebooks cell by cell, and ELF programs as their header and sections, without another program. A converter above is used in preference. The result is read-only.

app.about: An open source differencing and merging tool written in Rust.
app.drop_fill: Drop to fill in the empty paths
app.drop_overlay_desc: Two or three files or folders open side by side; a single item opens the Open dialog.

cmd.copy_all_from_right: Copy all from right to middle
col.name: Name
diffs.changed_on_disk: {file} changed on disk after it was read, so it was not saved. Discard the changes to it with the button on its card to read it again.
diffs.discard: Discard the changes to this file and read it again
diffs.empty_or_missing: An empty file on one side, missing on the other
diffs.format_only: Only the line endings, encoding or final newline differ.
diffs.ignored_only: Only differences ignored by the compare options or rules.
diffs.kept: Files with unsaved changes were not read again.
diffs.outdated: The folder compare found more files with differences since this tab was opened. To list them, save the changes here, close this tab and open All differences again.
diffs.reread: {file} changed on disk and was read again; check the change before copying.
diffs.stopped: The folder compare was stopped, so the files it didn't compare are not listed.
diffs.tip: Show the differences of every changed file side by side in one tab, to merge them
diffs.undo_lost: {file} could not be read again, so its last change could not be undone.
diffs.unsaved: Save or undo the changes first.
dlg.patch_folder: Select the folder the patch applies to
dock.hint: Select a file to see its differences here.
dock.load_failed: The files could not be read.
dock.not_text: Not a text file. Press Enter to compare it in its own tab.
filters.hint: Filters decide which files and folders are compared. WinMerge-compatible .flt files are loaded from the Filters folders.
folder.empty_hidden: All items are hidden by the View settings
folder.empty_none: No files or folders were found
folder_sync.compare_again: The folders changed. Close this and compare them again before synchronizing.
folder_sync.confirm_detail: {replaces} files there will be replaced and {deletes} items deleted. Each file is checked against this preview first; if applying fails or is stopped, the changes made so far are undone. Changes to several files are not one atomic step.
folder_sync.confirm_tick: I understand that {n} items will be deleted
folder_sync.discard: Keep the folders as they are
folder_sync.discarded: The record was removed; the folders were left as they are.
folder_sync.err_changed: The file changed after the preview
folder_sync.err_changed_after: Changed again since the synchronization; left as it is
folder_sync.err_future_version: This plan has format version {n}, made by a newer OxideMerge
folder_sync.err_in_use: Another OxideMerge window is using this synchronization
folder_sync.err_incomplete: Synchronization needs a complete comparison: compare subfolders, including those found on one side only, and let the comparison finish.
folder_sync.err_journal_inside: The recovery journal would be inside a synchronized folder
folder_sync.err_nested: One folder is inside the other; they cannot be synchronized
folder_sync.err_newer_journal: Recorded by a newer OxideMerge; undo it with that version
folder_sync.err_other_folders: This plan was made for other folders; make a new plan for these
folder_sync.err_plan_altered: The plan file was altered: its id does not match its contents
folder_sync.err_read_only: Neither folder may be changed, so neither can be synchronized.
folder_sync.err_root_unreadable: {path} is not a folder that can be read
folder_sync.err_same_folder: Both sides are the same folder
folder_sync.err_unreadable: {path} cannot be read now; another program may have it open
folder_sync.err_unfinished: An earlier synchronization of these folders did not finish; undo it or keep its changes first
folder_sync.err_no_space: Not enough free space on {path}: {need} needed, {free} free; nothing was changed
folder_sync.err_verify: {path} does not hold what was copied
folder_sync.failed_undone: Applying failed and every change was undone: {reason}
folder_sync.kept: {n} folders were kept because they still hold items the comparison did not list:
folder_sync.nothing: The destination already matches; there is nothing to change.
folder_sync.planning: Reading the files the synchronization would change…
folder_sync.preview_only: Preview only — nothing has been changed yet
folder_sync.reason_changed_since_compare: Not on disk as the comparison found it; compare again
folder_sync.reason_link: Symbolic link: never followed or copied
folder_sync.reason_name_clash: The name differs from another only in case or Unicode form, which the file system may treat as the same name
folder_sync.reason_type_differs: A file on one side and a folder on the other
folder_sync.recovery_detail: Some changes could not be undone. Copies of the replaced and deleted files are kept in {path}.
folder_sync.recovery_next: To finish, deal with what each line names (a program holding the file open, a full disk, a missing permission, or a file changed since), then choose “Undo those changes” again from the recovery list: undoing again is safe and skips what is already back. Or restore the files by hand from the copies.
folder_sync.renamed_detail: Renamed or moved in the source: {from} → {to}. Applied by moving the file in the destination; copied and deleted only when the two folders are on different drives.
folder_sync.risk_destructive: Overwrites or deletes in the destination
folder_sync.stopped_undone: Stopped. The {n} changes made were undone.
folder_sync.summary: Create {dirs} folders · copy {copies} files · replace {replaces} · delete {deletes} · {bytes} to copy
folder_sync.summary_renames: {n} of the copies have the contents of a deleted file: renamed or moved in the source
folder_sync.tip: Preview making one folder match the other, then apply it
folder_sync.title: Synchronize folders
folder_sync.unfinished: A synchronization of {left} and {right} did not finish. {n} changes to {root} were recorded.
folder_sync.wait_to_close: A folder synchronization is changing files. Stop it or let it finish before closing.
folder_sync.warn_conflicts: {n} items are left alone because it is not safe to decide; see Conflict.
folder_sync.warn_excluded: The filter or hidden-file setting left items out of the comparison: they are neither copied nor deleted, so the destination may not end up an exact mirror.
folder_sync.warn_large_deletion: This deletes {n} items; you will be asked twice.

msg.archive_not_writable: {file} can't be written back: it is a signed package, which this app opens read-only.
msg.archive_read_only: {file} is read-only, so the edits were not written back into it.
msg.archive_changed: {file} changed on disk after it was opened, so the edits were not written back into it. Compare it again to edit the new version.
msg.archive_write_failed: Could not write the edits back into {file}.
msg.archive_replace_failed: Could not replace the archive with the updated copy.
msg.archive_password_needed: {file} is password-protected. Enter its password to open it.
msg.archive_password_wrong: The password for {file} is wrong. Try again.
msg.changed_on_disk: {file} was changed by another program. Reload it and lose your edits?
msg.changed_since_plan: changed after the merge was planned; compare again
msg.backup_listed: left as it is: its backup (.bak) would replace a compared file
msg.folder_merge_undone: The merge was undone: the middle folder is as it was
msg.folder_merge_not_applied: Nothing was merged: the middle folder is as it was
msg.folder_merge_copies_kept: Copies of the files as they were before the merge are kept in {folder}
msg.folder_merge_copies_left: The merge is done, but the copies kept for undo in {folder} could not be removed: {error}
msg.changed_since_compare: changed after the comparison; compare again
msg.outside_folder: would be written outside the middle folder, through a symbolic link; left as it is
msg.paste_not_hex: Only hexadecimal bytes, such as DE AD BE EF, can be pasted here. Paste text in the text column.
msg.copy_into_itself: Cannot copy an item onto itself or into itself
msg.exit_unsaved: Some files have unsaved changes. Save them before exiting?
msg.finder_registered: The Finder Quick Actions were added
msg.finder_unregistered: The Finder Quick Actions were removed
msg.fm_registered: The file manager context menu entries were added
msg.fm_unregistered: The file manager context menu entries were removed
msg.folder_merge_conflicts: {n} item(s) cannot be merged automatically and are left as they are: changed on both sides, unreadable, symbolic links, or a file on one side and a folder on another:
msg.folder_merge_incomplete: Auto merge needs a complete comparison: compare subfolders, including those found on one side only, and let the comparison finish.
msg.folder_merge_stale: {n} item(s) changed after the comparison, such as {file}; compare again (F5) before merging.
msg.folder_merge_nothing: Nothing to merge: the left and right folders have no changes to bring into the middle folder.
msg.folder_merge_plan: Merge into the middle folder: {copies} item(s) copied, {deletes} deleted, {merges} text file(s) merged.
msg.image_missing: Both images must exist to compare them
msg.need_paths: Please select the files or folders to compare
msg.new_hint: Paste text with Ctrl+V into the active side, or double-click a line to type
msg.no_config: The settings folder could not be found.
msg.config_kept: The settings in {file} could not be read, so the defaults are used. A copy was kept as {kept}.
msg.config_left: The settings in {file} could not be read, so the defaults are used and settings are not saved over it.
msg.settings_not_saved: The settings could not be saved: {err}
msg.no_conflicts: The file contains no conflict markers
msg.no_listed_different_files: None of the listed files have differences
msg.no_more_files_yet: No more files with differences yet; the folders are still being compared.
msg.no_more_files_stopped: No more files with differences among those compared; the comparison was stopped before the end.
msg.no_next_conflict_file: No more files with open conflicts after this one
msg.no_next_file: No more files with differences after this one
msg.no_prev_conflict_file: No more files with open conflicts before this one
msg.no_prev_file: No more files with differences before this one
msg.too_many_paths: {n} paths were given: compare two or three files or folders at a time
msg.patch_applied: Applied {n} hunks; review the result and save the right side
msg.patch_no_target: Could not find the file to patch: {file}
msg.patch_too_many: Only the first {n} files of the patch were opened
msg.patch_two_way: Patches can only be created from a 2-way compare
msg.project_needs_files: Open a comparison of two or three items to save it as a project
msg.read_only_disk: {file} is read-only on disk and was not saved. Save it under another name.
msg.side_read_only: {side} side is read-only. To edit it, click the lock in its header.
msg.side_compare_only: {side} side shows text read from the file: it can be compared, but not edited.
msg.extracted_over_document: The text shown here was read from a file and cannot be saved as {file}: that kind of file is itself read by converting it, and plain text would replace its contents. Choose a plain text file name instead.
msg.reloaded: Reloaded {file}, which was changed on disk
msg.report_folder_only: Reports are available for folder and text compares
msg.rule_added_refresh: Rule added to "{name}". The folder compare uses it too; refresh it (F5) to apply.
msg.shell_registered: The Explorer context menu entries were added
msg.shell_unregistered: The Explorer context menu entries were removed
msg.stats_unavailable: Statistics are available for text and folder compares.
msg.text_compare_only: Only text compares can be saved as a comparison.
msg.unmappable: {file} was not saved: {encoding} can't hold some of its characters. Undo the change that added them.
opt.backup_on_save: Keep a .bak copy when saving over a file
opt.block_filters_hint: One block per line: start regex => end regex. Differences inside a block are ignored.
opt.ignore_comments_hint: Changes that are only in comments do not count, for languages whose comment syntax is known (C-like, scripts, SQL, HTML/XML, ...).
opt.invalid_regex: Not a valid regular expression, ignored: {pattern}
opt.line_filters_hint: One regular expression per line. Differences consisting only of matching lines are ignored.
opt.numeric_tolerance_hint: Lines that differ only in numbers at most this far apart count as equal.
opt.prettify: Format JSON and XML before comparing
opt.prettify_hint: JSON and XML files are shown re-indented (JSON keys sorted) and read-only, so only real content changes remain.
opt.recycle_bin: Use the recycle bin when deleting
tab.keep_for_recovery_tip: While on, this comparison and its unsaved edits are kept for recovery. Turn it off for a comparison whose unsaved text should not be written to disk.
opt.highlight_limit_tip: Larger files, or ones of more than 3,125 lines for each MB, are shown without syntax highlighting, which takes time and memory for every line.
view.syntax_over_budget: Syntax highlighting is off for {file}: it is larger than the {mb} MB set in Options → General.
view.syntax_over_line_budget: Syntax highlighting is off for {file}: it has more than the {lines} lines allowed by the {mb} MB set in Options → General.
open.title: Opening
recovery.kept: The unsaved text of {n} of them is open in new text compares, and kept for recovery until you save it.
recovery.not_written: The recovery snapshot could not be written ({error}), so the snapshots you restored are kept to offer again at the next start.
recovery.restored: Restored {n} comparisons; their recovered edits are not saved.
recovery.left_out: {n} sides had too much unsaved text to keep.
recovery.never_saved: Restored edits stay unsaved until you save them.
recovery.found: OxideMerge did not close normally. From {saved}: {tabs} comparisons, {unsaved} sides with unsaved edits.
recovery.title: Recover your work?
opt.recovery_tip: While OxideMerge runs, keep the open comparisons and the text of unsaved edits in a private folder of the settings, to offer them again if it does not close normally. Nothing is ever written to the compared files.
opt.rules_hint: Lines to ignore, substitutions and blocks to ignore are kept in rules files. The selected file is used by default; a folder compare can pick another from its toolbar, and the context menu of a text compare adds rules. Import rules files shared by others, or drop .oxrules files on the window.
opt.structured_equal: Treat JSON, XML, TOML and YAML files with the same structure as identical
opt.structured_equal_hint: Full contents only. Files whose text differs are read as structured data; when the values are the same (key order, formatting and comments aside), the files count as identical. Other files are compared as before. In TOML and YAML, numbers compare by value: 30 equals 30.0.
opt.substitutions_hint: One rule per line: regex => replacement. Applied before comparing.
opt.unpackers_hint: Unpackers convert files to text before comparing. ${file} is replaced by the file path; the output is read from stdout.
palette.hint: Search commands, recent comparisons and settings
palette.title: Command palette
peek.binary: Binary file. Press Enter to compare.
peek.folder: Folder. Press Enter to compare its contents.
peek.hint: Space or Esc to close · ↑ ↓ to move · Enter to open
peek.too_large: Too large to preview. Press Enter to compare.
report.err_no_font: No font could be read for the PDF report.
report.err_page_size: The page size of the PDF report is not valid.
report.missing_glyphs: {n} characters have no font on this computer and print as ?: {chars}
report.title: Folder compare report
report.too_long: Too long to show here ({n} lines).
report.cut_note: Long blocks show their first {rows} rows, and long lines their first {chars} characters.
report.extracted_lines: Line numbers count the lines of the text read from these files, not the lines of the files themselves.
report.files_unique: Files present on one side only
report.limits: Up to {rows} rows in all, {hunk} rows per block and {chars} characters per line; files up to {size} and {lines} lines.
report.omissions: Not everything is in this report
report.omit_detail_summary: {n} differences are listed without their lines (Summary detail).
report.complete: This report shows every difference in full
report.limits_full: every row of every difference, whole lines; files up to {size} and {lines} lines.
report.limits_summary: counts and where each difference is, without their lines; a folder report reads no file.
report.omit_summary: {n} changed files are listed without their differences (each says why).
report.omit_limit: {n} diff blocks are left out: the report holds up to {rows} rows.
report.omit_cut: {n} diff blocks are shortened: up to {rows} rows per block and {chars} characters per line.
report.paths_hidden: Folder paths are hidden. File names and the differences shown can still be sensitive.
report.search_partial: Blocks left out or shortened are searched only as far as they are shown.
report.search_scope: Searches the differences shown in this report, in either view.
report.why_folder: A folder: there are no file differences to show.
report.why_scope: This report lists the files only; export it with differences to see them.
report.why_detail_summary: This report lists the files only ({detail} detail); export it with more detail to see their differences.
report.why_bytes: Its differences are left out: the report already holds {size} of differences.
report.omit_bytes: {n} diff blocks are left out: the report holds up to {size} of differences.
report.why_unknown: Its differences could not be shown.
report.same_text_bytes_differ: {read}: no differences. The files differ in bytes that this text leaves out.
report.pdf_limits: Up to {rows} drawn lines in all, a wrapped line counting once for each line it takes; files up to {size} and {lines} lines.
report.omit_limit_pdf: {n} diff blocks are left out: the report draws up to {rows} lines.
report.omit_cut_short_pdf: The last diff block shown is cut short where the report reached its limit of {rows} drawn lines.
rules.add_hint: Patterns are regular expressions. This compare uses the changed rules file immediately; other folder compares using it pick up the change when refreshed (F5).
rules.blocks: Ignore blocks between start and end lines
rules.editing: Save or cancel the rules file being edited first.
rules.exists: A rules file named "{name}" already exists.
rules.export_all: All rules files to a folder...
rules.fix_unclear: Fix the lines marked above before saving.
rules.missing: The compare rules file “{name}” could not be read, so compares run without it.
rules.unclear_lines: Lines {lines} could not be split into two patterns: write “ => ” once between them.
rules.unreadable: “{name}” could not be read, so it was not changed.
rules.unsaved_edit: The rules being edited are not saved. Repeat the action to discard the changes.
rules.will_create: A new rules file "{name}" will be created.
start.conflict_desc: Open a file containing merge conflict markers and resolve it in a 3-way view.
table.ambiguous_copy: This row's key is ambiguous, so it is not copied. Make the key unique or edit the cells by hand.
tip.modified: Changed since it was opened or saved; not saved yet
tip.read_only_disk: You can edit here, but the file cannot be written: save it under another name
tip.compare_only: This is text OxideMerge read from the file (a document, spreadsheet, PDF, program, web page or formatted copy). It can be compared, but not edited or saved back.
tip.eol: End of line style used when saving
tip.insert_mode: Insert typed bytes instead of replacing the bytes at the cursor
tip.nav_all_diffs: Through the differences of every changed file, in the order of the folder list. Stops at the end; it does not wrap around.
tip.nav_conflict: Open conflicts only. In a three-way folder compare, goes on through the files changed on both sides, passing over those without open conflicts. Stops at the end; it does not wrap around.
tip.nav_diff: In this file, then, in a compare opened from a folder compare, on to the next changed file in the order of the list. Stops at the end; it does not wrap around.
tip.rules: Compare rules file: lines to ignore, substitutions and blocks to ignore. Refresh (F5) reads it again.
tip.sync_renames: Copies whose contents match a file the plan deletes
tip.table_order: The order the matched rows are shown in. Key order sorts numbers by value, before text.
tip.table_tolerance: Numbers this close count as equal: 0.01 is a difference, 1% a fraction of the larger number. Empty compares exactly.
view.folder_file_pane: File compare below the folder list
web.skipped: {n} resource(s) skipped: web pages are not allowed to load resources from this computer or a private network
web.md_identical: The pages show the same formatted content
sync.no_line: There is no line here to synchronize
sync.pick: Line {line} of {side} picked for a synchronization point: now pick the matching line in {others}
sync.added: Synchronization point added ({n} in this compare)
sync.unpicked: Line no longer picked for a synchronization point
sync.crossing: Not added: the lines would cross another synchronization point
menu.pdf_letter: US Letter pages for PDF reports
menu.report_hide_paths_tip: Reports name the compared folders by their sides instead of showing their paths. The differences shown can still contain sensitive text.
menu.remote_in_place_tip: Write over a file on the server directly, instead of uploading a complete copy beside it and then swapping it in. In place keeps access-control lists and hard links, which a swapped-in copy loses, but an interrupted save can leave the file partly written. FTP always saves in place.
slides.title: Comparison slideshow
slides.hint: Use ← → or Space to move between slides, and F for full screen
slides.omit_limit: {n} diff blocks are left out: a slideshow holds up to {slides} slides.
slides.omit_cut: {n} diff blocks are shortened: a slide shows up to {rows} rows.
slides.limits: Up to {slides} slides and {hunk} rows per slide; files up to {size} and {lines} lines.
table.err_cancelled: Matching by key was stopped, so rows are matched by position.
table.err_failed: Matching by key failed, so rows are matched by position.
table.err_duplicate_key_column: {side} has more than one column named “{column}”, so rows are matched by position. Choose another key.
table.err_missing_key: {side} has no key column “{column}”, so rows are matched by position.
table.err_no_header: Pairing columns by name needs a header row, so rows are matched by position.
table.err_too_large: Tables with more than {count} records are matched by position.
table.copy_columns_differ: The two sides have their columns in a different order, so whole records can't be copied. Edit the cells by hand.
table.stale: The document changed while this cell was being edited. Reopen the cell and try again.
table.warn_duplicate_header: {side}: the column name “{column}” appears more than once; such columns are paired in order.
table.warn_duplicate_keys: {side}: {count} records share their key with another record and are not matched.
table.warn_empty_keys: {side}: {count} records have an empty or missing key and are not matched.
table.warn_unpaired: {side}: columns not on the other side are not compared: {columns}
table.invalid: Invalid table data. Switch to text view to correct it.
table.matching: Matching rows by key: {done} of {total} records…
review.label: Portable folder review
review.finish_first: Finish the comparison and file operations before saving a review.
review.select_first: Select files or folders to include in the review.
analysis.save_result_first: Save the merge result to a file before validating its bytes.
analysis.mechanical_only: Mechanical checks only; semantic correctness and build/test success are not guaranteed. Preview does not write files.
analysis.formatted_tip: Show the documents formatted, with headings, lists, images and tables, merged cells included
analysis.three_way_summary: {n} paths differ from the middle file; {conflicts} in conflict
analysis.ambiguous_hint: Another reading of this change is equally likely; check it by hand.
analysis.paired_by_key: Elements paired by the array matching key.
analysis.paired_by_reordering: Elements paired as an exact reordering of the array.
analysis.paired_by_position: Elements paired by position in arrays of different lengths: an insertion shifts every later element.
analysis.array_key_hint: Member that identifies array elements, e.g. id
analysis.copy_moved: Moves are not copied: a move changes the order of the whole array. Reorder it in the Text view.
analysis.copy_no_edit: This value cannot be copied by changing only the text where it is written; edit it in the Text view.
analysis.copy_stale: The file no longer reads, or no longer holds this value where it was found. Wait for the comparison to finish, or compare again.
analysis.semantic_identical: Semantically identical under the displayed policies
analysis.semantic_policy: Object keys and XML attributes are unordered; arrays, XML text whitespace, comments and child order are significant. Text ignore rules are not applied. Copying a value changes only the text where it is written.
baseline.title: Release summary / Compare baselines
baseline.syntax: Sources: folder:PATH · git:REV:PATH · review:SIDE:PATH (snapshot side starts at 0). Git uses trusted local Git configuration.
baseline.invalid: Invalid baseline source; check the source syntax.
baseline.captured: Frozen captured bytes. Opened comparisons are read-only. Excluded or unreadable paths are not counted as identical.
impact.title: Potential impact
impact.exact: Exact — an import resolves to the changed file
workspace.title: Review workspace
workspace.select_hunk: Select a difference to review it.
workspace.ambiguous: Context is stale or ambiguous; review again. Repeated contexts are never automatically accepted.
workspace.renamed_from: Carried over from {path}, which held the same content
workspace.ambiguous_rename: Copied from {path}: several files hold its content, so review this one again
analysis.repreview: Inputs or rules changed; preview the merge again.
analysis.value_limit: Value previews are limited to 512 characters; use source or export for complete values.
analysis.preview_limit: Preview shows at most 200 lines and 500 characters per line; export the full plan for complete content.
analysis.too_large: Review analysis is limited to 16 MiB per decoded text input; use normal text comparison.
analysis.tree_tip: Both XML files as one aligned tree: matching elements share a row, with a placeholder where a node exists on one side only. Read-only.
analysis.tree_policy: Tree view: each row pairs a node with its counterpart, so an inserted sibling is one addition and counts can be lower than the Semantic view's path-by-path changes. Attributes are unordered; child order, text whitespace and comments count, as in the Semantic view. Read-only.
analysis.tree_tip_values: Both files as one aligned tree: object members share a row by key and array elements are aligned, with a placeholder where a value exists on one side only. Read-only.
analysis.tree_policy_values: Tree view: object members are paired by key and array elements are aligned, so an inserted element is one addition and counts can be lower than the Semantic view's path-by-path changes. Values compare as in the Semantic view: key order, comments and formatting are ignored, and TOML and YAML numbers compare by value (1 equals 1.0) while JSON numbers do not. Read-only.
analysis.tree_search_hint_values: Name, value or path such as $.server.port
analysis.tree_keys_tip_values: Pair the objects of an array by member values instead of by position: array@member, + for several members, ; between rules. They apply to this view only.
analysis.tree_pairing_member: Paired by key, as object members.
analysis.tree_pairing_identity: Paired by the value of its id, name or key member.
analysis.tree_search_hint: Name, value or XPath such as //book[@id='1']
analysis.tree_keys_tip: Pair repeated elements by attribute values instead of by position: element@attribute, + for several attributes, ; between rules. They apply to this view only.
analysis.tree_identified_tip: No key rule covers these arrays and every object in them has a unique id, name or key member, so they are paired by it. Type a key rule to pair them otherwise.
analysis.tree_key_warning: Key rule {rule} was not used where keys repeat or are missing ({duplicates} duplicate, {missing} missing): those elements are paired conservatively and marked ambiguous.
analysis.tree_moved_detail: moved from position {from} to {to} among its siblings
analysis.tree_pairing_exact: Paired as identical content, or as attributes of the same name.
analysis.tree_pairing_name: Paired by kind and name between other paired siblings.
analysis.tree_stale: The previously selected node is no longer in the comparison.
analysis.tree_hidden_by_filter: The selected change is hidden by this filter.
analysis.tree_collection_nested: These elements hold child elements, which the table does not show; use the tree for them.
baseline.renamed_from: suspected rename from {path}; {n}% of lines match
view.layout_help: Aligned rows leave blank space for inserted or deleted lines. Compact rows show each side without that space. In a binary comparison, aligned rows also line up moved blocks.
start.baselines_desc: Compare two folders or saved reviews as releases.
merge.mark_resolved_tip: Keep the middle of this conflict as it is, for example after editing it by hand
msg.inline_read_only: The inline view only shows the files. To edit them, open the side-by-side view.
tip.edit_side_by_side: Open the side-by-side view with the text cursor on this line (Enter, F2 or double-click a line)
start.three_way_tip: Add a common base between the two sides for a 3-way merge
start.try_desc: Open two small sample folders to see how differences, filters and merging work.
msg.job_folder_only: Save as job works from a folder comparison.
msg.job_temp_folders: Only folders on disk can be saved as a job, not a revision, a web page or an archive.
job.name: Name
job.report_hint: Relative to the job file; .html, .pdf, .csv, .txt or .xml
job.plan_hint: Relative to the job file; a JSON plan to check or apply later
job.mirror: Mirror: make the destination match, deleting what only it has
job.update: Update: copy new and changed files, delete nothing
job.relative: Store paths relative to the job file
job.sync_note: A sync job changes folders only after you agree, each time it runs. On the command line it needs --yes.
job.two_folders: Only a comparison of two folders can be synchronized.
job.not_run: Not run, because a job before it failed
job.err_newer: The job file is version {version}, newer than this OxideMerge reads ({max})
job.err_bad_version: The job file has version {version}; versions start at 1
job.err_no_version: Not a job file: it has no "version"
job.err_no_jobs: The job file lists no jobs
job.err_not_for_kind: "{field}" does not apply to a {kind} job
job.err_apply: A sync job changes the destination only with "apply": true; use a sync_plan job to plan without changing anything
job.err_env_unset: The environment variable {name} is not set
job.err_needs_yes: This job changes {path} and runs only when allowed: --yes on the command line
job.err_outside: This job writes {path}, outside the job file's folder, and runs only when allowed: --yes on the command line
job.err_large_deletion: This synchronization would delete {n} items; set "allow_large_deletion": true in the job to allow it
job.confirm_large: It may delete many files without asking again ("allow_large_deletion")
job.confirm_outside: This job file writes outside its folder:
job.not_run_stopped: Not run, because the run was stopped
folder_sync.copy_links_tip: A link is synchronized as the link itself: made, replaced or deleted, with the text of its target compared. What it points to is never read or changed. A link facing a file or folder of the same name is left alone.
